name: @pipeworx/mcp-dwds

tools.name: snippet
tools.description: Dictionary entry summary for a German word from DWDS.de — part of speech (Wortart), the base lemma, and a link to the full dictionary entry. Example: snippet({ query: "Haus" }).

tools.name: dwds_frequency
tools.description: How common a German word is: its absolute hit count and per-million frequency in the DWDS reference corpus. Answers "how frequent is the German word X", "how common is <word>". Example: dwds_frequency({ query: "Haus" }).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dwds forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dwds pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
